hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: lookup structure on the total time t in [1, len(changeIndices)].

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: In Part II, an index can be reset to 0 in 1 second; map each index to its first occurrence.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Traverse backwards from t - 1 down to 0, using a min-heap to greedily keep the best reset operations while ensuring sufficient time slots.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.time: O((m + n log n) log m)
complexity.notes: Binary search on monotonic completion time with reverse min-heap greedy check.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential search over reset vs decrement choices is infeasible.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that reset operation is only useful on first occurrence and priority queue resolves greedy conflicts.
